problems.problem: Bottle appears to float with no visible contact shadow or surface cues. The product_base_y (1245) is 86.5% of canvas height (1440), but the shadow.offset_y (0) is detached from the bottle base, violating contact shadow physics. No visible tabletop or floor texture to ground the bottle.

Typography is disconnected from the product. The title ("J'adore") and logo ("Dior") are placed in the upper right, creating a split visual flow between the bottle (left) and text (right). The product occupies 59% of canvas height (850/1440), which is within range, but the text placement lacks integration with the bottle's form.

Compared to professional references (e.g., Tom Ford Figue with fig integration, Byredo Rose of No Man's Land with bold graphic elements), the composition lacks a cohesive visual narrative. The burgundy background and diagonal shadow are generic, failing to create the thematic depth seen in luxury campaigns.

changes.value: Empty deep burgundy red studio with matte wine-red paper floor and wall, large diagonal architectural shadow from upper right, flat geometric color fields, editorial still-life set, clear foreground left, subtle texture on floor surface
